reporting-org.narrative: European Bank for Reconstruction and Development

description.narrative: A senior unsecured loan of up to EUR 5 million under the FIF - Regional - SME Go Green Programme to NLB Pristina (NLBP). Proceeds of the loan will be used for providing sub-loans to eligible SMEs in Kosovo to improve their competitiveness and trade potential via targeted investments in sustainability practices and the adoption of internationally recognised quality standards, scaling up green economy investments and in particular, greening of agribusiness supply chains and promoting more equitable access to climate and other finance to women-led SMEs. Investment incentives of 10-15% will be provided to sub-borrowers for the implementation of eligible investments in line with the Programme Policy Statement. NLBP will aim to deliver 100 percent of the proceeds to Green Economy Transition (GET) eligible projects.
